title: The Calderón problem for harmonic spinors
summary: We show that the conformal class of a compact spin manifold with boundary is uniquely determined by its boundary values of harmonic spinors if the metric is locally conformal to a real-analytic metric in some coordinates. More precisely, we consider the boundary conjugation (BC) map for the Dirac operator corresponding to MIT boundary conditions, and prove that if two locally conformally real-analytic (LCRA) metrics have equivalent BC maps over an open subset of the boundary, then the two manifolds are conformally equivalent.
